title: Web topology
description: docs/generated/web.json: every web surface this repository exposes, resolved once from its producer — the routes the executable answers itself, the static trees a generator writes under the generated root, and the application that owns the site — with the mount each claims, in route-precedence order (ADR 0013). Written by `majordomus generate web`.

generated_root.description: The directory a producer writes a static surface into, repository-relative.

reserved.description: The mounts the executable keeps for itself, by the name each is known by; a discovered surface may not claim one.

producer.description: What writes or answers this surface; the owner a reader goes to.

availability.description: Where the surface means anything: served by the running executable and published as files, answered only by the process, or published as files it also serves.

provenance.description: Where each value of this surface came from, by field.
